title: AI Scam Losses and Banking Fears: Evidence vs. Speculation
description:
J Bravo’s AI banking warning raises a practical question: how do you prepare without letting fear drive your money decisions? We compare reported internet-crime losses, then unpack his cited 6–12-month planning scenario for banking, internet and utility disruptions. We separate that planning from his speculation about stablecoins and government control, examine his warning about fear-driven selling, and explain his physical security-key recommendation and its limits. We also cover his preference for gold and housing over speculative Bitcoin, without treating that preference as a guaranteed strategy.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#Jbravo #JBravoAIbanking #AIbankingrisks #Housing #RealEstate

hook: Reported internet-crime losses reached $20.877 billion in 2025, versus $16.6 billion in 2024.
reporter_prompt: Five-second horizontal opening featuring a middle-aged American male reporter in a navy blazer, standing on a public sidewalk outside an American retail bank branch, with its entrance and ATM clearly visible behind him. Soft daylight, approachable expression, calm conversational delivery. Do not portray him as J Bravo or imply this is J Bravo's location. Use real-looking American surroundings without invented bank branding. Add all typography in postproduction, not inside generated footage. Acro
